description.subtitle: Valencia Puma shorts - black
description.tagline: Perform at your best with freshness and freedom
description.intro: These Valencia shorts offer a perfect combination of lightness, breathability and dynamic fit. Ideal for high intensity sessions and maximum mobility on the playing field.
key_benefits: Freedom of movement: Lightweight and breathable design to perform in every session.
Elastic waist with drawstring: Customized and secure fit.
Material reciclado: Compromiso con el medio ambiente sin sacrificar rendimiento.
Official club design: proudly represents Valencia CF.
